{{Quote|Leaderless, the fleet has reverted to its most primal function: extermination. Unchecked, they will destroy all life in the galaxy.|[[Valkorion]], to [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]]|<ref name="KOTET 9" />}}
In [[3630 BBY]], at the end of the [[war against Zakuul]], Empress of Zakuul [[Vaylin]] was killed during the [[Assault on Odessen]],<ref name="KOTET 8" /> but this caused the leaderless [[Eternal Fleet]] to revert to its primal programming. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was one of many that was '''bombarded''' by the [[Eternal Fleet warship]]s in an effort to eradicate all life in the galaxy. The bombardments eventually ended when the Alliance Commander took control of the [[Eternal Throne]] during the [[Battle of Zakuul]].<ref name="KOTET 9" />
